data.name: Dark Magician
data.desc: The ultimate wizard in terms of attack and defense.

data.name: Magician's Rod
data.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Dark Magician" from your Deck to your hand.

data.name: Magicians' Souls
data.desc: You can send 1 Level 6 or higher Spellcaster monster from your Deck to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand.

data.name: Test Starter
data.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Spellcaster monster from your Deck.

data.name: Test Extender
data.desc: If this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card from your GY. You can only use this effect of "Test Extender" once per turn.

data.name: Pot of Greed
data.desc: Draw 2 cards.

data.name: Monster Reborn
data.desc: Target 1 monster in either GY; Special Summon it.

data.name: Called by the Grave
data.desc: Target 1 monster in your opponent's GY; banish it, and if you do, until the end of the next turn, its effects are negated.

data.name: Crossout Designator
data.desc: Declare 1 card name; banish 1 of that declared card from your Main Deck, and if you do, negate its effects.

data.name: Mystical Space Typhoon
data.desc: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

data.name: Eternal Soul
data.desc: You can activate 1 of these effects. You can only use this effect of "Eternal Soul" once per turn.

data.name: Decode Talker
data.desc: 2+ Effect Monsters. Gains 500 ATK for each monster it points to.

data.name: Number 39: Utopia
data.desc: 2 Level 4 monsters. When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can detach 1 material from this card; negate the attack.

data.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
data.desc: When a card or effect is activated that includes any of these effects (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; negate that effect. You can only use this effect of "Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring" once per turn.

data.name: Maxx "C"
data.desc: (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand to the GY; this turn, each time your opponent Special Summons a monster(s), immediately draw 1 card. You can only activate 1 "Maxx "C"" per turn.

data.name: Effect Veiler
data.desc: During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand to the GY, then target 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls; negate the effects of that face-up monster until the end of this turn.

data.name: Infinite Impermanence
data.desc: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; negate its effects until the end of this turn. If you control no cards, you can activate this card from your hand.

data.name: Droll & Lock Bird
data.desc: If a card(s) is added from the Main Deck to your opponent's hand, except during the Draw Phase (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand to the GY; for the rest of this turn, neither player can add cards from the Main Deck to the hand.

data.name: Nibiru, the Primal Being
data.desc: During the Main Phase, if your opponent Normal or Special Summoned 5 or more monsters this turn (Quick Effect): You can Tribute as many face-up monsters on the field as possible, and if you do, Special Summon this card from your hand, then Special Summon 1 "Primal Being Token" to your opponent's field.

data.name: Ghost Ogre & Snow Rabbit
data.desc: When a monster on the field activates its effect, or when a Spell/Trap Card that is already face-up on the field activates its effect (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand or field to the GY; destroy that card on the field.

data.name: Ghost Belle & Haunted Mansion
data.desc: When a card or effect is activated that includes any of these effects (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; negate the activation.

data.name: Raigeki
data.desc: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.

data.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
data.desc: Destroy all Spells and Traps your opponent controls.

data.name: Dark Ruler No More
data.desc: Negate the effects of all face-up monsters your opponent currently controls, until the end of this turn.

data.name: Evenly Matched
data.desc: At the end of the Battle Phase, if your opponent controls more cards than you do: You can make your opponent banish cards from their field face-down so they control the same number of cards as you do. If you control no cards, you can activate this card from your hand.
